summary_ru: Тестовая система BioETL зрелая: ~2935 test_*.py, 530 architecture-guards, канонические lanes в test_matrix.yaml, inventory skip/flaky/VCR, CI test-matrix + coverage-verify 85%. Слабые места: GitHub ruleset pr-gate отключён (каталог advisory), на PR не гоняется e2e-nightly-full при MUST e2e для composition/interfaces; flaky-телеметрия узкая (N=3, два файла). Локально Windows/WSL — шесть architecture platform skip.
top_remediations: После восстановления Actions billing включить ruleset 13643213 или явно документировать альтернативный merge-blocker (#11180).
Не ослаблять PR e2e-smoke: держать e2e-matrix-health.yml matrix-smoke-blocking зелёным; планировать nightly e2e-nightly-full-replay как release confidence.
Расширять flaky-telemetry только с бюджетом минут и новым inventory owner — не трактовать пустой flaky_test_inventory как доказательство стабильности.
Windows-разработчикам опираться на architecture-fast-boundary + CI Linux как merge-truth (#10418 skips).
Продолжать кампанию slim VCR для четырёх allowlist_oversized кассет (>10 MiB).

findings.expected: GitHub ruleset pr-gate-complete физически блокирует merge при падении canonical checks.
findings.actual: Enforcement disabled из-за Actions billing (#11180); статусы каталога advisory до восстановления billing.
findings.impact: Merge в main может не иметь принудительной GitHub ruleset-блокировки; дисциплина merge опирается на добровольный прогон workflow, а не на ruleset.
findings.root_cause: Actions billing (#11180) — включение ruleset заблокировало бы main без runnable checks.
findings.remediation: Восстановить billing → включить ruleset 13643213; до этого держать pr-required.yml и локальный pr_gate.py как операционный контракт.

findings.method: read test_matrix e2e-nightly-full and layers.composition/interfaces e2e MUST
findings.observation: e2e-nightly-full-replay skipped on pull_request; layers mark e2e MUST for composition and interfaces.
findings.expected: Критичный offline cassette-replay E2E сигнал до merge или эквivalent blocking PR satellite.
findings.actual: Полный e2e-nightly-full только schedule/workflow_dispatch; PR satellite e2e_smoke не входит в pr-gate-complete.
findings.impact: Регрессии полной cassette-replay цепочки pipeline могут попасть в main до nightly.
findings.remediation: Сохранить e2e-matrix-health matrix-smoke-blocking; мониторить skip-rate SLO; не ослаблять e2e-smoke без ADR.
validation: read configs/quality/test_matrix.yaml lanes e2e-nightly-full and layers

evidence.observation: composition layer e2e: MUST; PR satellite e2e_smoke not required merge check

findings.observation: e2e-smoke явно not a GitHub-required merge check and not pr-gate-complete owner.
findings.expected: Документированный advisory статус и отдельный CI owner (GHA-017 satellite).
findings.impact: PR merge не требует e2e-smoke; регрессии matrix smoke возможны без блокировки pr-gate-complete.
findings.remediation: Операторы должны смотреть e2e-matrix-health на PR; не добавлять e2e_smoke в pr-gate без ADR.

evidence.observation: e2e_smoke marker documents same advisory policy

findings.observation: reviewed_flaky_tests: []; review_notes warn empty list is not proof of no flakes; CI N=3 on two paths only.
findings.expected: Repeated-run telemetry или явный scope limitation в audit.
findings.actual: flaky-telemetry job runs 3 seeds on semanticscholar contract + determinism_identity_policy only.
findings.impact: Intermittent failures вне shard могут оставаться незамеченными до полного CI или локального прогона.
findings.remediation: Расширять shard только с inventory owner; использовать SWARM/local test-health для диагностики.

findings.observation: Six architecture tests skip on NTFS/WSL mounted worktree timeout; CI Linux is merge-truth.
findings.expected: Документированные platform guards с owner и permanent_policy.
findings.impact: Windows-local полный architecture governance feedback неполный; риск ложного зелёного локально.
findings.root_cause: Filesystem/git census latency on NTFS/WSL mounts.
findings.remediation: Локально: architecture-fast-boundary; merge decisions — CI Linux.

findings.observation: coverage-verify excludes e2e, benchmark, memory from repo-wide 85% gate.
findings.expected: Единственная lane с coverage_gate repo-wide; exclusions documented.
findings.actual: marker: not e2e and not benchmark and not memory; pyproject.toml omits fail_under for shard partial runs.
findings.impact: E2E/memory/perf paths не входят в 85% merge gate — регрессии там ловятся другими lanes.
findings.remediation: Не смешивать e2e в coverage-verify без lane redesign; держать e2e SLO и nightly replay.

evidence.observation: not e2e and not benchmark and not memory

findings.observation: prompt-tests-nightly runs tests/prompts/ only schedule/manual; not on pull_request.
findings.expected: Nightly aggregate fail-closed for prompt library contracts.
findings.actual: Lane description matches; no github_required_checks entry for prompts.
findings.impact: Prompt-library regressions могут пройти PR без блокировки.
findings.root_cause: Cost — prompt tests joined into nightly E2E aggregate only.
findings.remediation: Запускать prompt-tests-nightly на schedule; при изменении tests/prompts — локальный lane.

findings.method: rg pytest.skip( tests -g *.py -c file count; read inventory policy
findings.observation: 123 test modules contain pytest.skip(; only 2 files use @pytest.mark.skip outside architecture meta-tests; unit_unconditional_skips: [].
findings.expected: Runtime skips in integration/contract/e2e listed in test_skip_inventory entries.
findings.actual: Inventory documents contract/integration skips; unit conditional skips excluded from census by design.
findings.impact: Большой объём runtime skip calls требует дисциплины inventory sync (architecture test_test_skip_inventory).
findings.root_cause: Opt-in live/VCR/LFS guards implemented as pytest.skip not decorators.
findings.remediation: При добавлении unconditional skip in unit — list in unit_unconditional_skips (#11173).

findings.observation: Contract tests skip without BIOETL_LIVE_API_TESTS; network-marked modules use connectivity probe.
findings.expected: Default CI/dev runs replay-only; live opt-in explicit.
findings.actual: Seven contract modules use pytestmark network; flaky-telemetry excludes -m network.
findings.impact: Live provider outages produce skips not failures in opt-in runs — может скрыть деградацию если live gate слабый.
findings.remediation: Merge-blocking paths must stay VCR/replay; live canaries only scheduled/opt-in.

evidence.observation: Skip contract tests if BIOETL_LIVE_API_TESTS is not set

findings.observation: Four chembl VCR cassettes exceed 10 MiB budget with removal_condition re-record.
findings.expected: New cassettes blocked >10 MiB; legacy allowlisted with owner.
findings.actual: allowlist_oversized lists 4 paths tied to e2e chain/matrix tests.
findings.impact: Repo size and replay latency; not a merge blocker if lanes pass.
findings.remediation: Re-record slim cassettes per removal_condition; do not raise max_new_cassette_bytes.

findings.method: read budgets markerless_test_functions_max and architecture assertions
findings.observation: markerless_test_functions_max: 0; architecture tests assert markerless_test_functions == 0 in closeouts.
findings.expected: No unmarked test functions in governed surface.
findings.actual: Budgets explicit no-growth ratchets in test_governance_audit.yaml.
findings.impact: Positive — reduces unclassified tests slipping into wrong lanes.
findings.root_cause: Epic test governance program (#4161 et al.).
findings.remediation: Maintain report_test_governance_audit refresh on test surface changes.

findings.observation: strict-markers, strict-config, importlib mode, filterwarnings error, timeout 60s thread method.
findings.expected: Deterministic local defaults; serial default (no global xdist in addopts).
findings.impact: Reduces hang/flake from warnings and unknown markers.
findings.remediation: Keep CI explicit xdist only in sharded lanes.

findings.observation: E2E skip-rate SLO blocking 15% on evaluation lanes; forbid_retries_to_heal_flakes: true.
findings.expected: Skips observed not healed by pytest reruns (#9729).
findings.impact: High skip rate on e2e lanes should fail CI when evaluated.
findings.remediation: Triage skip categories in telemetry artifact e2e-skip-rate-telemetry.

findings.method: read memory lane and tests.yml memory-tests job
findings.observation: Dedicated memory lane for Neo4j MCP smoke; excluded from coverage-verify.
findings.expected: memory marker isolates optional Neo4j dependency from unit-fast/coverage.
findings.actual: tests.yml memory-tests job runs test_neo4j_memory_mcp_smoke.py with -m memory.
findings.impact: Positive isolation; memory failures don't dilute coverage gate.
findings.remediation: Keep memory out of default local unit-fast invocations.

findings.observation: Architecture test forbids tracked *.disabled test modules bypassing collection and skip inventory.
findings.actual: Guard documented with rationale in module docstring.

findings.observation: Canonical tests gate lists smoke-check, governance-preflight, test-fast, test-matrix, coverage-verify as always_required.
findings.actual: integration canonical_check id maps to test-matrix shard in catalog.
findings.impact: Positive — layered feedback before aggregate coverage.
findings.remediation: When ruleset restored, align live check names with catalog ids.

findings.observation: Canonical integration roots and VCR replay provider families documented with cassette paths.
findings.expected: Single policy for integration vs live default.
findings.impact: Positive — reduces ad-hoc live HTTP in integration lanes.
findings.remediation: Architecture test_integration_vcr_policy stays in governance preflight.

findings.observation: ~2935 test_*.py files; ~530 under tests/architecture; 44 contract; 28 e2e module files counted.
findings.expected: Large architecture governance surface documented for operators.
findings.actual: Counts from worktree e1c184857e46 file inventory.
findings.impact: Full local architecture suite slow on Windows (#10418); CI sharding required.
findings.remediation: Use pytest_shards.yaml S1–S7 and test_health wrappers for local runs.
